none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Nikita Kornilov, Eduard Gorbunov, Mohammad Alkousa, Fedor Stonyakin, Pavel Dvurechensky, Alexander Gasnikov. [Intermediate Gradient Methods with Relative Inexactness](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.00506v1). 2023 (preprint v1; published 2025). Complexity: $O(1+\max\{\sqrt{LR^2/\varepsilon},\alpha^{1/3}(LR^2/\varepsilon)^{2/3},\alpha LR^2/\varepsilon\})$ fixed relative-error gradient oracle calls for $f(y^N)-f^*\le\varepsilon$, provided $\varepsilon\ge C\alpha^2LR^2$, with sufficiently large universal $C$; Intermediate Similar Triangle Method with $p=2$.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization of f:E→ℝ. The objective satisfies the global quadratic smoothness inequality with public L>0 and has a minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0−xstar‖≤R, where R≥0 is public.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: A query x∈E returns g∈E satisfying ‖g−∇f(x)‖≤α‖∇f(x)‖ for every call index and seed. Only gradient information is supplied; function values are unavailable. The public error parameter satisfies 0≤α<1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: Arbitrary bias and dependence between oracle calls are permitted; no unbiasedness, independence, or distributional noise restriction is imposed beyond the uniform relative-error bound.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The error bound is pointwise relative to the true gradient norm, uniformly over all x, call indices k, and seeds. Errors vanish at stationary points.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is an arbitrary real Hilbert space, with no finite-dimensional restriction. E, x0, L, α, R, and ε are public because Params=Public and publicInput is the identity; f and its minimizer are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Gradient.Public; LongTails/Setups/RelativeErrorSmoothConvex.lean: Public, spec.Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return one point output∈E satisfying f(output)−f(xstar)≤ε for a global minimizer xstar, with public ε>0.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law. The oracle-call budget is fixed and must hold for every seed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex minimization is classical, but this formulation uses a uniformly bounded relative-error gradient oracle permitting arbitrary bias and dependence, with an almost-sure guarantee in an arbitrary Hilbert space.
